name: stale-facts
about: Facts that change over time, told to an assistant in the first person. For each subject, the statement valid at an instant is the one with the latest `at` at or before it; every other statement of that subject is wrong at that instant. A statement marked learnedLate is told after everything else (an old fact mentioned today). Distractors are ordinary facts that share words with the questions. Written by hand for this benchmark; not drawn from any other dataset.
